name: io.github.Credda-io/credda-trust
title: Credda Trust
description: Check a counterparty's verifiable Credda trust record; verify or present signed credentials.

environmentVariables.name: CREDDA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Credda platform API key. Without it the public read/verify tools still work; with it the platform tools (score reads, monitors, usage) are enabled.

environmentVariables.name: CREDDA_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional. The external id this server presents credentials for; needed only by mint_my_trust_token and present_my_credential (with CREDDA_API_KEY).

environmentVariables.name: CREDDA_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Optional override for the Credda API base URL, e.g. for a staging deployment.
